questions.question_english:

Assertion (A): A Principal can legally detain a 10-year-old child in the same class if the child fails the annual examination repeatedly.
Reason (R): The Right to Education (Amendment) Act, 2019 modified the original 'No Detention Policy', allowing States to hold regular examinations in classes 5 and 8 and detain a child if they fail the re-examination.

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The RTE (Amendment) Act, 2019 replaced the absolute 'No Detention Policy' by allowing States to conduct regular examinations in classes 5 and 8 and detain students who fail re-examinations. The reason accurately explains the statutory amendment enabling the Principal's detention action under updated state rules.

I. अनुच्छेद 45: प्रारंभिक बाल्यावस्था देखभाल और शिक्षा
II. अनुच्छेद 46: अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों और अन्य कमजोर वर्गों के शैक्षिक हितों को बढ़ावा देना
III. अनुच्छेद 21क: सभी नागरिकों के लिए शिक्षा का अधिकार
कौन-से युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following pairs of Constitutional Articles and their subject matter:
I. Article 45: Early childhood care and education
II. Article 46: Promotion of educational interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections
III. Article 21A: Right to Education for all citizens Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.explanation_english: Article 45 pertains to early childhood care and education for children below six years, and Article 46 deals with promoting educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and weaker sections. Article 21A, however, specifically guarantees free and compulsory education to children between six and fourteen years, rather than universally extending to all citizens of all age categories.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I और II है। संशोधित अनुच्छेद 45 छह वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों की प्रारंभिक देखभाल और शिक्षा से संबंधित है। अनुच्छेद 46 राज्य को अनुसूचित जातियों, अनुसूचित जनजातियों और अन्य कमजोर वर्गों के शैक्षिक तथा आर्थिक हितों को विशेष देखभाल के साथ बढ़ावा देने का निर्देश देता है। अनुच्छेद 21क का अधिकार सभी नागरिकों के लिए सामान्य अधिकार नहीं, बल्कि 6 से 14 वर्ष आयु के बच्चों के लिए निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य शिक्षा का मौलिक अधिकार है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 45 pertains to early childhood care and education for children below six years, and Article 46 deals with promoting educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and weaker sections. Article 21A, however, specifically guarantees free and compulsory education to children between six and fourteen years, rather than universally extending to all citizens of all age categories.

options_hindi: अनुमति देनी चाहिए, क्योंकि अल्पसंख्यकों को संस्थान स्थापित और संचालित करने का अधिकार है।
केवल संबंधित धार्मिक अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय के विद्यार्थियों को इसमें भाग लेने देना चाहिए।
अनुरोध अस्वीकार करना चाहिए, क्योंकि राज्य निधि से पूर्णतः संचालित संस्थानों में धार्मिक शिक्षा नहीं दी जा सकती।

questions.question_english: A Principal of a government school is approached by a religious minority group requesting permission to conduct compulsory religious instruction for all students during school hours. According to Article 28 of the Constitution, what is the most appropriate action for the Principal?
options_english: Allow the instruction, as minorities possess the constitutional right to establish and administer educational institutions freely.
Allow the instruction exclusively for those students who actively belong to that specific religious minority group.
Deny the request, as state-funded educational institutions cannot provide religious instruction.
Seek formal prior administrative approval from the Directorate of Education before permitting any religious instruction.
questions.explanation_english: Article 28(1) of the Constitution explicitly prohibits any religious instruction in educational institutions that are wholly maintained out of State funds. Since a government school is entirely funded and operated by the State, conducting compulsory or optional religious instruction during school hours is constitutionally prohibited, requiring the institutional head to refuse the request to maintain secular public education standards.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर C है। अनुच्छेद 28(1) ऐसे शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में धार्मिक शिक्षा देने पर रोक लगाता है जो पूर्णतः राज्य निधि से संचालित होते हैं। सरकारी विद्यालय इस प्रतिबंध के अंतर्गत आते हैं, इसलिए केवल किसी अल्पसंख्यक समूह के अनुरोध या प्रशासनिक स्वीकृति से वहाँ अनिवार्य धार्मिक शिक्षा की अनुमति नहीं दी जा सकती। यह प्रावधान राज्य-संचालित शिक्षा में धर्मनिरपेक्षता की संवैधानिक व्यवस्था का हिस्सा है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Deny the request, as state-funded educational institutions cannot provide religious instruction.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 28(1) of the Constitution explicitly prohibits any religious instruction in educational institutions that are wholly maintained out of State funds. Since a government school is entirely funded and operated by the State, conducting compulsory or optional religious instruction during school hours is constitutionally prohibited, requiring the institutional head to refuse the request to maintain secular public education standards.

questions.question_english: Read the situation below and answer the question that follows: A local authority issues an order making it mandatory for all schools in the district, including linguistic minority schools, to teach the local state language as the primary medium of instruction. Which Constitutional right of the linguistic minority school is most directly infringed?
questions.explanation_english: Article 30(1) grants religious and linguistic minorities the fundamental right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. Forcing a linguistic minority school to adopt a specific regional language as its primary medium of instruction violates its core administrative autonomy to choose its instructional medium.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: अनुच्छेद 30(1)। यह धार्मिक और भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों को अपनी पसंद के शैक्षणिक संस्थान स्थापित करने और उनका प्रशासन करने का मौलिक अधिकार देता है। किसी अल्पसंख्यक संस्था पर बिना उचित संवैधानिक आधार के एक विशिष्ट भाषा को अनिवार्य प्रमुख शिक्षण-माध्यम बनाने का आदेश उसकी शैक्षणिक और प्रशासनिक स्वायत्तता को प्रभावित कर सकता है। अनुच्छेद 350क प्राथमिक स्तर पर भाषाई अल्पसंख्यक बच्चों को मातृभाषा में शिक्षा की सुविधाएँ देने के प्रयास से संबंधित है, लेकिन प्रश्न का मुख्य अधिकार अनुच्छेद 30(1) है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Article 30(1)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 30(1) grants religious and linguistic minorities the fundamental right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. Forcing a linguistic minority school to adopt a specific regional language as its primary medium of instruction violates its core administrative autonomy to choose its instructional medium.

questions.question_english: Read the situation below and answer the question that follows: The Directorate of Education, GNCTD, implements a policy reserving a percentage of seats in specialized schools of excellence for students from socio-economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Which Article provides the strongest constitutional backing for such an affirmative action policy in education?
questions.explanation_english: Article 15(4) provides explicit constitutional enabling authority to the State for making special provisions for the advancement of socially and educationally backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes. Reserving educational seats for socio-economically disadvantaged students directly draws its constitutional validity from this protective discrimination clause.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर अनुच्छेद 15(4) है। यह अनुच्छेद राज्य को सामाजिक और शैक्षणिक रूप से पिछड़े वर्गों तथा अनुसूचित जातियों और अनुसूचित जनजातियों की उन्नति के लिए विशेष प्रावधान करने की स्पष्ट अनुमति देता है। शिक्षा में लक्षित आरक्षण और अन्य सकारात्मक उपाय इसी संवैधानिक आधार से समर्थित हो सकते हैं। अनुच्छेद 16(1) सार्वजनिक रोजगार में अवसर की समानता से संबंधित है, न कि शैक्षणिक प्रवेश में आरक्षण का मुख्य प्रावधान।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Article 15(4)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 15(4) provides explicit constitutional enabling authority to the State for making special provisions for the advancement of socially and educationally backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and Scheduled Tribes. Reserving educational seats for socio-economically disadvantaged students directly draws its constitutional validity from this protective discrimination clause.

questions.question_english: The judicial interpretation that elevated the Right to Education to the status of a Fundamental Right was initially derived from which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India?
questions.explanation_english: The Supreme Court of India initially recognized education as an integral component of human dignity under Article 21, which guarantees the right to life and personal liberty. key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Article 21

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Supreme Court of India initially recognized education as an integral component of human dignity under Article 21, which guarantees the right to life and personal liberty. Landmark legal precedents established that living with dignity requires access to basic learning, establishing Article 21 as the constitutional foundation for educational rights before Article 21A was formally inserted.

questions.question_english: The fundamental duty of every citizen who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child was added to the Constitution in the year:
questions.explanation_english: The fundamental duty under Article 51A(k)— requiring every parent or guardian to provide educational opportunities to their child between six and fourteen years of age—was incorporated into Part IVA of the Constitution through the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, which was enacted in the year 2002.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 2002

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The fundamental duty under Article 51A(k)— requiring every parent or guardian to provide educational opportunities to their child between six and fourteen years of age—was incorporated into Part IVA of the Constitution through the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, which was enacted in the year 2002.

questions.question_english:
Consider these statements regarding the application of Article 14 (Right to Equality) in schools:
I. It prohibits arbitrary fee hikes by government-aided schools.
II. It requires that all students, regardless of physical disabilities, must be taught in the exact same manner without any special accommodations.
III. It forms the basis for inclusive education policies, ensuring reasonable accommodations are provided to level the playing field. 
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Article 14 prevents arbitrary administrative decisions like unreasonable fee hikes and demands reasonable classification for disadvantaged groups, forming the foundation of inclusive education. Statement II is incorrect because treating disabled students identically without reasonable accommodations fails equal protection by ignoring relevant functional differences.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Article 136 empowers the Supreme Court to grant Special Leave to Appeal (SLP) against any judgment, decree, or order in any cause or matter passed by any court or tribunal in India. It serves as an extraordinary constitutional remedy frequently invoked in landmark educational litigation.

questions.question_hindi:
राष्ट्रीय बाल अधिकार संरक्षण आयोग (NCPCR) और शिक्षा के अधिकार के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. NCPCR अनुच्छेद 338ख के अंतर्गत स्थापित संवैधानिक निकाय है।
II. RTE अधिनियम, 2009 के अंतर्गत यह बच्चे के शिक्षा-अधिकार की निगरानी करने का दायित्व निभाता है।
III. यह निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य शिक्षा के अधिकार के उल्लंघन से जुड़ी शिकायतों की जाँच कर सकता है।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Constitutional Provisions Related to Education
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Examine the following statements about the role of the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) and the Right to Education:
I. NCPCR is a constitutional body established under Article 338B.
II. NCPCR is mandated to monitor the child's right to education under the RTE Act, 2009.
III. NCPCR can inquire into complaints regarding the violation of the right to free and compulsory education. 
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: NCPCR is a statutory body established under the Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005 (not a constitutional body under Article 338B), making statement I incorrect. Statements II and III accurately describe NCPCR's statutory mandate under the RTE Act, 2009 to monitor child rights and inquire into violations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: II और III। NCPCR एक वैधानिक निकाय है, जिसे बाल अधिकार संरक्षण अधिनियम, 2005 के अंतर्गत स्थापित किया गया; यह अनुच्छेद 338ख के अंतर्गत संवैधानिक निकाय नहीं है। RTE अधिनियम के अंतर्गत इसे बच्चों के शिक्षा-अधिकार की निगरानी और उल्लंघन संबंधी शिकायतों की जाँच की भूमिकाएँ दी गई हैं। इसलिए पहला कथन गलत है, जबकि दूसरे और तीसरे कथन सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: NCPCR is a statutory body established under the Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005 (not a constitutional body under Article 338B), making statement I incorrect. Statements II and III accurately describe NCPCR's statutory mandate under the RTE Act, 2009 to monitor child rights and inquire into violations.

questions.question_hindi:
शिक्षा में संवैधानिक निकायों की भूमिका के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG) सरकारी विद्यालयों और समग्र शिक्षा जैसी प्रमुख योजनाओं के खातों तथा सार्वजनिक व्यय का लेखा-परीक्षण करते हैं।
II. निर्वाचन आयोग जनप्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम के तहत चुनावी कार्यों के लिए विद्यालयी शिक्षकों की सेवाएँ ले सकता है और सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने ऐसी तैनाती को संवैधानिक माना है।
III. वित्त आयोग राज्यों को अनुदान की सिफारिश करता है, जिसमें प्राथमिक शिक्षा के लिए स्थानीय निकायों को सहायता भी शामिल हो सकती है।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Constitutional Provisions Related to Education
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Examine the following statements about the role of constitutional bodies in education:
I. The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG) audits the accounts of government schools and major centrally sponsored schemes like Samagra Shiksha.
II. The Election Commission of India can requisition the services of school teachers for election duties under the Representation of the People Act, which the Supreme Court has upheld as constitutional.
III. The Finance Commission recommends grants-in-aid to States which includes funding for local bodies to support primary education. 
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: The CAG audits public expenditure in education; the Election Commission can legally deploy teachers for election duties as upheld by the Supreme Court; and the Finance Commission recommends local body grants supporting primary education. Thus, all three statements correctly describe constitutional roles in education.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: I, II और III। CAG सार्वजनिक धन के उपयोग और शिक्षा-संबंधी व्यय का लेखा-परीक्षण कर सकता है। चुनावी कार्यों के लिए शिक्षकों की तैनाती कानून के अंतर्गत संभव है, और न्यायालयों ने चुनाव-प्रशासन के लिए ऐसी सेवा-आवश्यकता को स्वीकार किया है। वित्त आयोग राज्यों और स्थानीय निकायों के लिए अनुदान संबंधी सिफारिशें करता है; स्थानीय निकायों की क्षमता और प्राथमिक शिक्षा जैसी सेवाओं को समर्थन देने में इन अनुदानों की भूमिका हो सकती है। तीनों कथन शिक्षा प्रशासन में निगरानी, चुनावी दायित्व और वित्तीय विकेंद्रीकरण के अलग-अलग पहलुओं को बताते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The CAG audits public expenditure in education; the Election Commission can legally deploy teachers for election duties as upheld by the Supreme Court; and the Finance Commission recommends local body grants supporting primary education. Thus, all three statements correctly describe constitutional roles in education.

questions.question_hindi: 42वें संविधान संशोधन द्वारा ‘शिक्षा’ को समवर्ती सूची में स्थानांतरित किए जाने से पहले, संविधान की राज्य सूची (सूची II) की किस प्रविष्टि में शिक्षा रखी गई थी?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Constitutional Provisions Related to Education
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Under which entry of the State List (List II) was 'Education' placed before it was transferred to the Concurrent List by the 42nd Amendment Act?
questions.explanation_english: Prior to the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976, 'Education, including universities' was listed under Entry 11 of the State List (List II) in the Seventh Schedule. The amendment omitted Entry 11 from List II and placed education under Entry 25 of List III (Concurrent List).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: प्रविष्टि 11। 42वें संविधान संशोधन, 1976 से पहले ‘शिक्षा, जिसमें विश्वविद्यालय भी शामिल थे’ राज्य सूची की प्रविष्टि 11 के अंतर्गत आती थी। संशोधन ने इस प्रविष्टि को हटाकर शिक्षा को समवर्ती सूची की प्रविष्टि 25 में स्थानांतरित कर दिया। अतः शिक्षा अब सामान्यतः केंद्र और राज्यों, दोनों के विधायी अधिकार-क्षेत्र में आती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Entry 11

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Prior to the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976, 'Education, including universities' was listed under Entry 11 of the State List (List II) in the Seventh Schedule. The amendment omitted Entry 11 from List II and placed education under Entry 25 of List III (Concurrent List).

questions.question_hindi:
सेंट स्टीफेंस कॉलेज बनाम दिल्ली विश्वविद्यालय मामले के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. यह राज्य सहायता प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक संस्थान में प्रवेश और अल्पसंख्यक कोटे के प्रश्न से संबंधित था।
II. सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने कॉलेज को अपने अल्पसंख्यक चरित्र को बनाए रखने के लिए ईसाई विद्यार्थियों हेतु 50 प्रतिशत तक सीटें रखने की अनुमति दी।
III. इसने यह स्थापित किया कि सहायता-प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक संस्थान कोई अलग प्रवेश प्रक्रिया नहीं अपना सकते।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Constitutional Provisions Related to Education
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider these statements regarding the landmark case of St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi:
I. It dealt with the admission process and minority quota in a state-aided minority institution.
II. The Supreme Court allowed the college to maintain a quota (up to 50%) for Christian students to preserve its minority character.
III. It established that aided minority institutions cannot have a separate admission process. 
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: In St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi (1992), the Supreme Court allowed aided minority institutions to reserve up to 50% seats for their community to preserve minority character. Statement III is incorrect because the Court permitted aided minority institutions to maintain their own interview-based admission procedures alongside university criteria.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: I और II। सेंट स्टीफेंस कॉलेज बनाम दिल्ली विश्वविद्यालय (1992) मामले में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने सहायता-प्राप्त अल्पसंख्यक संस्थान को अपने अल्पसंख्यक चरित्र को बनाए रखने के लिए अपने समुदाय के विद्यार्थियों को प्रवेश में प्राथमिकता देने की अनुमति दी, जिसमें स्रोत के अनुसार 50 प्रतिशत तक सीटों की व्यवस्था शामिल थी। तीसरा कथन गलत है क्योंकि न्यायालय ने उपयुक्त सीमाओं के भीतर विशेष प्रवेश नीति को स्वीकार किया था; उसने सभी अलग प्रवेश प्रक्रियाओं पर पूर्ण प्रतिबंध नहीं लगाया।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In St. Stephen's College v. University of Delhi (1992), the Supreme Court allowed aided minority institutions to reserve up to 50% seats for their community to preserve minority character. Statement III is incorrect because the Court permitted aided minority institutions to maintain their own interview-based admission procedures alongside university criteria.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संविधान संशोधन शैक्षणिक अधिकारों, आरक्षण या शिक्षा के प्रशासनिक ढाँचे से सीधे संबंधित नहीं है?
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Constitutional Provisions Related to Education
questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english: Which one of the following Constitutional Amendments is NOT directly related to educational rights, reservations, or administrative structures impacting education?
questions.explanation_english: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST). Unlike the 42nd Amendment (Concurrent List), 44th Amendment (Article 30(1A)), and 86th Amendment (Article 21A), the 101st Amendment relates strictly to indirect taxation and carries no direct structural relation to educational rights.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है: 101वाँ संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम (GST)। 101वें संशोधन ने वस्तु एवं सेवा कर व्यवस्था के लिए संवैधानिक ढाँचा बनाया। 42वाँ संशोधन शिक्षा को समवर्ती सूची में स्थानांतरित करने के लिए, 44वाँ संशोधन संपत्ति के अधिकार और अनुच्छेद 30(1क) संबंधी सुरक्षा के लिए, तथा 86वाँ संशोधन अनुच्छेद 21क और शिक्षा संबंधी अन्य प्रावधानों के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण है। इसलिए GST वाला संशोधन शिक्षा-अधिकारों से सीधे संबंधित विकल्प नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) 101st Amendment Act (GST)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The 101st Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST). Unlike the 42nd Amendment (Concurrent List), 44th Amendment (Article 30(1A)), and 86th Amendment (Article 21A), the 101st Amendment relates strictly to indirect taxation and carries no direct structural relation to educational rights.
